skills.description: This skill should be used when business colleagues need to submit a data or business requirement to the development team. It asks for the fixed basic info fields (requirement name, submitter, department, who will use it, requirement type judged automatically), then collects each template section through plain-language Q&A, and outputs a paste-ready report exactly following the company's internal requirement template without adding any extra fields or designs.
